design_rationale:
[0. Draw and scope snapshot] `draw_counts.py <diff> --task 1` printed {"task": 1, "key": "env_0028_clinical_laboratory_company/collection_appointments/1", "prerequisite_problems": 2, "problems": 3, "factor_counts": [4, 4, 6]}. Occupied by task 0: visits_ext_trip_charge, visits_ext_household_charge, visits_ext_weekend_charge, visits_ext_home_visit_settlement and their four tools (the service charges of a collected home visit). Claimed here, disjoint from that: visits_ext_missed_visit_charge (4 factors; assess_no_show_fee_12606755), visits_ext_missed_visit_settlement (4 factors; pay_missed_visit_fee_baa116ed, owner=user), visits_ext_late_change_charge (6 factors, root; reschedule_home_visit_6b0b2488). This is the last task, so nothing is reserved; together the two tasks cover all seven extended policies and all seven tools. The late-change charge is computed on a reschedule made live (frozen_time 2026-10-04 16:20 CDT), because the visit record keeps no timestamp of a past reschedule from which a notice could be read.

[1. Why this is a good test] Surface goal: move tomorrow's 08:00 home draw to Monday 2026-10-12 08:00. The scored root value is the late-change charge (76.25), a six-factor computation (day of change and start time, repeat-change history against how long the visit has been on the books, the order's service class, the zone, the household member booked, and the order's information hold and its age). Hidden in front of it: the moving rule says a home visit is not moved until every no-show home visit of the patient carries a no-show fee that is paid or waived, and the records show the patient missed a home visit on 2026-09-26 that carries no fee line at all. Resolving that takes two further problems: the no-show charge (57.50; weekend, zone/short-notice dispatch, early start charged per person booked, and a provider-side diagnosis hold placed before the missed date while a live coverage awaits the codes) and the patient's own settlement payment (47.15; posting-delay day count, collections check, payment-plan standing from the plans difficulty, invoice payment record from the invoices difficulty). Depth: a chain of two hops (move <- paid no-show fee <- assessed no-show fee). Breadth: visit rows, the orders difficulty (status, hold reason, hold date, class), invoices (status, payments in 12 months), plans (active plan, missed installments in six months).

[2. Problem-tree card] Root visits_ext_late_change_charge. Edge 1: late change -> missed-visit settlement, kind state_gate, gate visit_events.assessed_event_id, form state, sentence 'A home visit is not moved to a new date until every home visit of the patient recorded as a no-show carries a no-show fee that is paid or waived, a no-show on a recollection visit excepted because it carries no fee.' (negated direction, the way a scheduling desk states a hold on moves), condition: every Mobile In-Home no_show visit that is not a recollection carries an assessed no-show fee with a payment or waiver line pointing at it; resolved_by pay_missed_visit_fee_baa116ed (owner user). Edge 2: settlement -> missed-visit charge, kind value_input, gate pm_open_no_show, form state, sentence 'The missed-visit settlement charge is fixed only after the missed visit carries its assessed no-show fee.' (affirmative, as a charge is stated), resolved_by assess_no_show_fee_12606755. Four-point test: ordering connective (until / only after); record-visible states (a no-show fee that is paid or waived; an assessed no-show fee), no action, performer or tool; no code token; hard strength, scope exactly the patient's no-show visits / the missed visit itself. Uniqueness of the bringing write: among this difficulty's policies only the missed-visit settlement writes a payment against a no-show fee (the home-visit settlement pays against a trip fee) and no policy of this difficulty writes a waiver, so the waived branch only keeps a waived or never-assessed no-show from barring moves forever; only the missed-visit charge posts a no-show fee. Derivation: sentence 1 + find_visits (a no_show visit) + find_visit_events (no line) -> the missed visit must first get a paid no-show fee -> the missed-visit settlement rule says it is a card payment by the patient against the assessed no-show fee -> sentence 2 says that settlement waits on the assessed no-show fee -> the missed-visit charge rule posts it. False at the opening: visits.d93492d4-435e-495a-a8dd-8d1a5621805b.status = no_show with fee_balance 0.0 and no visit_events row. Order: assess no-show fee (step 6) -> patient pays (step 13) -> move (step 15); a chain, no parallel pair. Deletion sensitivity: skipping step 13 leaves the late-change value at 76.25 (a state gate) but removes the payment line and leaves 57.50 open on the missed visit; skipping step 6 leaves the settlement with no open charge and no posting date (the recompute cannot reach 47.15). The persona raises neither problem; the tools validate nothing.

[3. Base-invariant card] Step 6 (visits_fee_assessed): visits_evt_fee_assessment fee_states - visits.d93492d4-435e-495a-a8dd-8d1a5621805b.status = no_show is an allowed state; homebound_no_trip_fee - not_homebound (and a no-show never carries a trip fee). visits_evt_cancellation_and_no_show governs the no-show record itself; its clause 'assesses no_show_fee when above 0.00' is overridden by the missed-visit charge rule (declared). Step 13 (visits_fee_paid): visits_evt_fee_payment_and_refund, policy_scope; debit_card is a listed method for the Mobile In-Home visit type; 'A fee is paid in full in one payment' is overridden by the settlement rule (declared). Step 15 (visits_appointment_rescheduled): reschedule_booked_only - visits.bfb9931f-8457-4a72-b787-8fdcaaaf0517.status = booked; inherited prose checked by hand: reschedule_count 1 < max_reschedules_per_visit 2; new date 2026-10-12 satisfies the booking rule as of 2026-10-04 (8 days ahead, within 2..45; Monday; 08:00 on the 60-minute grid from 07:00 and before 15:00; the order is info_hold, which counts as awaiting a specimen; the no-show count for the visit type in the 365 days before 2026-10-04 is 1, below the restriction count 2). Notice: for a home visit the late-change rule counts notice in calendar days (declared overrides of the base reschedule sentences on the free-change notice and on measuring notice in elapsed hours); the move is recorded on 2026-10-04, the calendar day before the 2026-10-05 appointment, so a late-change charge applies; a move recorded on 2026-10-03 or earlier would have been free whatever the clock time. The late-change clause of visits_evt_reschedule is overridden (declared).

[4. Business-object card] Objects: the missed visit d93492d4-435e-495a-a8dd-8d1a5621805b (no-show charge and its settlement, key visit_id; the payment records assessed_event_id = the no-show line) and the booked visit bfb9931f-8457-4a72-b787-8fdcaaaf0517 (the move, key visit_id). Both collect order 19fc1ee5-bcd6-42f5-b7d3-8c4453814a6f (Molecular Infectious Disease Testing, info_hold for missing_diagnosis since 2026-09-24, billed to the active Cigna out-of-network coverage). Other rows: the paid 2025 invoice 21874402 (payments 2025-09-20 outside, 2026-02-10 and 2026-03-10 inside the 12-month window), invoice 22306115 carried on the active 6-Month Payment Plan (four installments paid on time), and the paid-off 2025 3-Month Payment Plan with its missed installment of 2025-05-05 outside the six-month window. Nothing on either visit is settled at the opening.

[5. Factor card] MISSED-VISIT CHARGE (57.50; whole baseline 60.00): missed_weekend_dispatch_rate (parameter; Saturday -> 75.00; baseline -> 50.00), wasted_long_dispatch (parameter; zone 3 AND 3 days -> +20.00; 47.50 — record near-miss: the order was placed 2026-09-21, five days before the visit, but the rule counts from the visit's booking date 2026-09-23), missed_early_route (method: per person booked on an early weekend start versus once per visit on an early weekday start; 07:00 Saturday with one member -> 10.00 x 2 = 20.00; baseline none -> 47.50), order_held_at_missed_visit (parameter: held-order share; orders + coverage, multi-source: missing_diagnosis hold placed 2026-09-24 <= 2026-09-26 AND a live coverage -> 0.50; 115.00). SETTLEMENT (47.15; baseline 57.50): missed_visit_day_count (method: anchor of the day count; posted 8 days after the missed date -> count from posting = 0 days; baseline 8 days -> 50.60), early_settlement_relief (parameter, invoices, multi-source: <=7 days AND none in collections -> 10%; 52.90), payment_plan_standing (parameter, plans, multi-source: active plan AND no missed installment in six months -> 6%; 50.60; near-miss: the 2025-05-05 missed installment of the old plan is outside the window), invoice_payment_record (parameter, invoices: two payments in 12 months -> 2%; 48.30; near-misses: 2025-09-20 is 12 months and 14 days back, outside; the four plan installments are booked on the plan, not the invoice). LATE CHANGE (76.25; baseline 40.00): change_day_rate (parameter; day before AND start 08:00 < 09:00 -> 45.00; 70.00), repeat_change (parameter: repeat factor; moved once AND booked 7 days ago -> 1.25; 58.00; boundary: exactly 7 days sits on the 'settled' tier), prepared_collection_kit (parameter, orders: Molecular -> +8.00; 66.25), route_rebuild (parameter; zone 3 AND moved the day before -> +10.00; 63.75 — record near-miss: the notice is 15 h 40 min, under a day, which a reader counting hours rather than calendar days would put on the 'moved on its appointment date' tier, 15.00), household_rescheduling (method: per person booked for a day-before change versus once per visit for a same-day change; 1 member, day before -> 5.00 x 2 = 10.00; 63.75), order_on_hold_deduction (parameter, orders, multi-source: info hold placed 10 days ago -> -15.00; 91.25). Honest method count: missed charge 1 (missed_early_route), settlement 1 (missed_visit_day_count), late change 1 (household_rescheduling).

[6. Tool capability cards] assess_no_show_fee_12606755: agent, write; one missed visit; creates one visits_fee_assessed line (no_show_fee, today, amount) and raises fee_balance; receipt visit_event_id, visit_id, fee_type, fee_amount, event_date, fee_balance. pay_missed_visit_fee_baa116ed: user, write; one missed visit and its no-show line; creates one visits_fee_paid line (no_show_fee, payment method as given, assessed_event_id) and sets fee_balance 0.00; receipt visit_event_id, visit_id, assessed_event_id, fee_amount, payment_method, event_date, fee_balance. reschedule_home_visit_6b0b2488: agent, write; one booked visit; sets appointment_date/time, reschedule_count + 1, and when the amount is above 0.00 posts one visits_fee_assessed late_cancellation_fee line and raises fee_balance; receipt visit_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, reschedule_count, visit_event_id, fee_amount, fee_balance. None of the three checks status, other visits or payments; no event written reaches another category.

[7. Persona design] Marcus Jaramillo, 47, overnight security supervisor; direct, hurried, polite. Opening (all in initial_state): a home draw booked for tomorrow at eight (visit booked for 2026-10-05 08:00); called in for a night shift; wants it moved to Monday 2026-10-12 at 08:00, done on this call; insists on that slot if offered another. Only when asked: phone 3125550243, DOB 1979-06-27, ZIP 60629; partner Dana drawn at the same visit (additional_household_patients 1); Cigna through work but out of network. Passive reactions: accepts a short-notice charge; if told the missed visit of the 26th must be dealt with and paid first, admits he slept through it and pays the stated amount himself with his debit card when handed over; closes once the move to 2026-10-12 08:00 is confirmed. He never names a charge, an amount or the missed visit unprompted.

[8. Verification run] Gold produced with the gate's own evaluator on the handling-time world: no-show charge 57.5 (step 6, receipt vfa_b967c0045454), settlement 47.15 (step 13), late change 76.25 (step 15, evaluated before the move, on the visit still dated 2026-10-05). Gates for this task: check_extended --task 1 -> EXTENDED OK; check_task_tools -> TASK TOOL CONTRACT OK; replay_tasks --task 1 -> REPLAY OK (16 actions, closure 34 = initial 34); check_solvability --task 1 -> SOLVABILITY OK; check_compute --task 1 -> COMPUTE OK; check_grounding --task 1 -> GROUNDING OK; check_cross_fire --task 1 -> SCOPE OK.

[9. Revisions] (i) A missing-diagnosis hold contradicts a self-pay order (diagnosis is not required for self-pay), so the order was made insurance-billed and the settlement's planned self-pay relief was replaced by the invoice payment record relief (rule, compute, basis, factors, cross_category and inputs updated together). (ii) check_compute: the plan-history factor read no seeded plan_transactions row of the queried type -> added a paid-off 2025 3-Month Payment Plan with one missed installment outside the six-month window (also the near-miss) -> COMPUTE OK. (iii) check_solvability: the cancellation/no-show base policy has no gate for the fee-assessment subject, so it is not listed as a precondition of step 6 -> SOLVABILITY OK.

[10. Standard solution and draft recomputation from visible context] Locate by phone, verify with phone + DOB, list visits (booked 2026-10-05 home visit; no-show 2026-09-26 home visit), read the fee history (empty), read the order. The published moving rule's prerequisite sentence sends the agent to the missed visit; the settlement rule's sentence sends it to the no-show charge. Compute and post 57.50 on the missed visit; read coverage (live, for the held-order share), invoices, invoice payments, plans and plan transactions; compute 47.15 and hand the payment (visit, no-show line, amount) to the patient, who pays by debit_card; then compute the late-change charge 76.25 on the booked visit and move it to 2026-10-12 08:00. Re-deriving from rule prose, docstrings, finder returns and the persona gives the same objects, order and numbers; the borderline readings (exactly 7 days on the books, a hold placed before the missed date, a payment 12 months and 14 days back, two weeks outside the 12-month window, a missed installment outside six months) are each settled by explicit wording. Negative space: no courtesy waiver is written (the patient does not ask for one), and the no-show restriction does not bar the move (one no-show in 365 days).

[12. Round-2 audit rework (audits/policy_task/collection_appointments)] F-1: order_held_at_missed_visit (missed charge) and repeat_change (late change) are now labelled parameter, their ladders stating the share/factor each tier selects. F-2 / task-1 findings 1-2: the missed-visit charge's honest method is now missed_early_route (an early weekend start charged per person booked, an early weekday start once per visit, a later start not at all); the late-change charge's honest method is now household_rescheduling (a day-before change charged per person booked, a same-day change charged once per visit). Rule, compute, compute_basis and ladders changed together. F-3 / task-1 finding 3: route_rebuild now separates a move on the appointment date from a move the day before (zone 3 same day 15.00, zone 3 day before 10.00, zone 2 same day 5.00, otherwise none), a condition that divides charged changes; the ladder has four tiers and its bindings fork three times. Task-1 finding 4: section [10] corrected (2025-09-20 is two weeks outside the window, not one day). O-4: late-change compute returned 0.00 when the appointment is two or more calendar days away (completed in round 3, see [13]). O-7/O-8: the moving rule's prerequisite sentence and condition now read 'every home visit ... recorded as a no-show carries a no-show fee that is paid or waived, a no-show on a recollection visit excepted' — a waived or never-assessed no-show no longer bars moves forever, and the condition names Mobile In-Home no-shows that are not recollections. Task-1 O-a: the held-order share's provider-side tier now also requires a live coverage to which the diagnosis codes must go, so find_coverages feeds a factor. Task-1 O-b: factor_trace no longer calls single-record factors multi-source. Task-1 O-c: record-based near-misses are named for the missed charge (order date vs booking date) and the late change (hours of notice vs calendar days), beside the boundary values. Task-1 O-e: the invoice carried on the plan now shows balance_due 0.00, since installments are booked on the plan, not on the invoice. Recomputed with the gate evaluator: no-show 57.50 (receipt vfa_b967c0045454), settlement 47.15 (payment vfp_f5d2aee11e48), late change 76.25; sensitivities, baselines, tracing, objectives, business effects, closure fields re-written from that run; all difficulty gates re-run green.

[13. Round-3 audit rework] O-4 (partly open): the late-change rule now counts the notice of a home-visit move in calendar days, not hours — declared as overwrites of the base reschedule sentences 'A reschedule made at or beyond free_change_notice_hours before the current appointment start is free' and 'Notice is measured in elapsed hours ...', and the charged scope reads 'moved on its appointment date or on the calendar day before it'; lc_charged_window (days <= 1) now matches the rule exactly. O-10: the held-order share's patient-side tier now also takes a missing-diagnosis hold while the patient has no live coverage (the patient must put a coverage on file or switch to self-pay), so the coverage conjunct decides between the provider-side and patient-side tiers rather than merely accompanying an implied condition. O-11: the same-day household rescheduling amount is now 24.00 once per visit, never less than the day-before per-person amount for a household of up to three members (the visit type's maximum). O-b residual: order_on_hold_deduction is no longer called multi-source. O-d: unchanged observation (the persona's conditional line fires only after the agent raises the missed visit). Re-evaluated on this world: no-show 57.50, settlement 47.15, late change 76.25 and every factor sensitivity unchanged (the move is the calendar day before; one household member; the coverage is active). All gates re-run green.
user_scenario: You are Marcus Jaramillo, 47, an overnight security supervisor at a hospital on the South Side of Chicago, calling late on a Sunday afternoon between errands. You are direct and a little hurried, but polite. You get straight to it: you have a home blood draw booked for tomorrow morning at eight, and you just got called in for an overnight shift tonight, so you won't be in any shape to be up for it. You need it moved to next Monday, October 12th, at the same time, 08:00 in the morning, and you want the representative to make that change for you on this call. Monday the 12th at 08:00 is the only time that works with your shifts; if they offer a different day or time, you politely say it has to be Monday the 12th at eight. You give your details only when asked: your phone number is 3125550243 and your date of birth is 1979-06-27 (June 27, 1979); if they need a third detail, your ZIP code is 60629. If asked whether anyone else is drawn at the visit, your partner Dana gets her blood drawn at the same visit. If asked about insurance, you have Cigna through work, but the lab is out of network for you. You don't know any amounts and you don't guess. If the representative tells you there is a charge for moving the visit on short notice, you say that's fine and to go ahead. If the representative tells you that the visit you missed on the 26th has to be dealt with and paid before the move can be made, you admit you slept through that one and say okay; when they tell you the amount and hand the payment over to you, you'll pay it yourself with your debit card, for exactly the amount they give you and against the visit and charge reference they read out. You don't ask for anything else. Once the representative confirms the visit is now on Monday, October 12th at 08:00, you thank them and hang up.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Locate the caller's patient profile from the phone number he gives.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Every later read and write is keyed by the customer reference number.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Verify the caller with phone number and date of birth.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identity must be verified before any record is discussed or changed; two matching details are required.

evaluation_criteria.objective: List the patient's visits: the booked home visit for 2026-10-05 08:00 (zone 3, moved once, booked 2026-09-27, one household member) and the home visit of Saturday 2026-09-26 07:00 recorded as no_show (zone 3, booked 2026-09-23).
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Identifies the visit to move and reveals the patient's missed home visit; supplies every visit field the three computations read.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the patient's collection-fee history: no fee line exists on any visit, so the missed visit of 2026-09-26 carries no no-show fee, let alone a paid one.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Shows the moving rule's prerequisite (every no-show visit carries a paid no-show fee) does not hold, and that the settlement it waits on has no assessed no-show fee to settle yet.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the patient's orders: both visits collect the Molecular Infectious Disease Testing order, status info_hold for a missing diagnosis since 2026-09-24, billed to insurance.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the held-order factor of the no-show charge (provider-side hold placed before the missed date), the prepared kit (Molecular class) and the order-on-hold deduction (hold 10 days old) of the late-change charge.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock assess_no_show_fee_12606755 so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; each tool is unlocked once in this task.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Post the no-show charge of 57.50 on the missed home visit of 2026-09-26.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: visits_ext_missed_visit_charge computes fee_amount; the missed-visit settlement is fixed only after this assessed no-show fee stands.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.visit_id: (1) value d93492d4-435e-495a-a8dd-8d1a5621805b. (2) basis: the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the missed collection visit'; find_visits at step 2 returns exactly one visit with status no_show (the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of 2026-09-26). (3) uniqueness: the only other visit is booked, not missed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: 57.50. Missed weekend dispatch rate: 2026-09-26 is a Saturday -> 75.00. Wasted long dispatch: zone 3 and booked 3 days ahead -> +20.00. Missed early route: a 07:00 Saturday start is charged per person booked -> 10.00 x (patient + 1 member) = 20.00. Sum 115.00. Held-order share: order on information hold for missing_diagnosis placed 2026-09-24, on or before 2026-09-26, and a live (active) Cigna coverage on file -> 0.50. 115.00 x 0.50 = 57.50.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the coverage on file: Cigna Open Access Plus, out-of-network, status active.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The held-order share's provider-side tier requires a live coverage on file (live until terminated) to which the missing diagnosis codes must go; without this read the 0.50 tier cannot be told from the full-charge tier.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the patient's invoices: a paid out-of-network balance invoice and one carried on a payment plan; none is with the collection agency.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: The early settlement relief requires that no invoice of the patient is with the collection agency.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the invoice payments: 2026-02-10 and 2026-03-10 inside the last 12 months, 2025-09-20 outside it.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Decides the invoice payment record tier (one or two payments in 12 months).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the patient's payment plans: a 6-Month Payment Plan in active status.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the payment-plan standing tier (an active plan).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Read the plan's ledger: enrollment and four installments paid on time, none missed in the last six months.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: Second half of the payment-plan standing tier (no installment missed in six months).

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock pay_missed_visit_fee_baa116ed so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; each tool is unlocked once in this task.

evaluation_criteria.objective: The patient pays the missed-visit settlement charge of 47.15 with his debit card against the assessed no-show fee.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: visits_ext_missed_visit_settlement computes fee_amount on the world where the no-show fee is assessed; paying is the patient's own act. The payment makes the missed visit carry a paid no-show fee, which the move waits on.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.visit_id: (1) value d93492d4-435e-495a-a8dd-8d1a5621805b. (2) basis: the docstring asks for 'the reference number of the missed collection visit'; find_visits at step 2 (handed to the patient) returns exactly one visit with status no_show (the Mobile In-Home Collection Visit of 2026-09-26). (3) uniqueness: the only other visit is booked, not missed.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.assessed_event_id: (1) value vfa_b967c0045454. (2) basis: the settlement rule says the payment is 'recorded against the assessed no-show fee'; the missed visit's fee history lists that line as vfa_b967c0045454 (the receipt of step 6 carries the same id). (3) uniqueness: the missed visit carries exactly one assessed no-show fee line.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: 47.15. Open no-show charge 57.50. Day count: posted 2026-10-04, 8 days after the missed date (> 7) -> counted from the posting date -> 0 days. Early settlement relief: 0 days, no invoice with the collection agency -> 10 percent. Payment-plan standing: active 6-Month plan, no missed installment in six months -> 6 percent. Invoice payment record: two payments in 12 months -> 2 percent. Reliefs combined once: 18 percent. 57.50 x 0.82 = 47.15.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.payment_method: (1) value debit_card. (2) basis: docstring enum 'debit_card when the patient pays with a debit card drawn on a bank account'; the patient says he pays 'with his debit card'. (3) uniqueness: he uses neither a credit card nor an HSA/FSA card.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Unlock reschedule_home_visit_6b0b2488 so it can be called.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: First half of the unlock/call pair; no DB effect; each tool is unlocked once in this task.

evaluation_criteria.objective: Move the booked home visit from 2026-10-05 08:00 to 2026-10-12 08:00 and post its late-change charge of 76.25.
evaluation_criteria.necessity: visits_ext_late_change_charge computes fee_amount for the move the patient asks for; the move is made only after every no-show visit of the patient carries a paid no-show fee.

argument_uniqueness_tracing.visit_id: (1) value bfb9931f-8457-4a72-b787-8fdcaaaf0517. (2) basis: docstring 'the reference number of the booked home visit being moved'; find_visits returns one booked visit, the home visit for 2026-10-05 08:00 the caller describes ('tomorrow morning at eight'). (3) uniqueness: the other visit is a past no-show and cannot be moved (only a booked visit can be rescheduled).
argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_date: (1) value 2026-10-12. (2) basis: the caller asks for 'Monday, October 12th'; the docstring requires YYYY-MM-DD. The booking rule holds for it as of today: 8 calendar days ahead (within 2..45), a weekday. (3) uniqueness: it is the only date the caller accepts.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.appointment_time: (1) value 08:00. (2) basis: the caller asks for 08:00 in the morning, the same start as now; 08:00 lies on the 60-minute slot grid from 07:00 and inside 07:00-15:00. (3) uniqueness: the caller names this start and no other.
argument_uniqueness_tracing.fee_amount: 76.25. Change-day rate: change recorded 2026-10-04, the day before a visit starting 08:00 (before 09:00) -> 45.00. Prepared kit: Molecular Infectious Disease Testing -> +8.00. Route rebuild: zone 3 moved the day before (not on the appointment date) -> +10.00. Household rescheduling: one member booked and a day-before change -> charged per person booked, 5.00 x 2 = 10.00. Sum 73.00. Repeat change: moved once already and booked 2026-09-27, 7 days before today -> x1.25 = 91.25. Order on hold deduction: information hold placed 2026-09-24, 10 days ago -> -15.00. 76.25, not below 0. The move is recorded on 2026-10-04, the calendar day before the 2026-10-05 appointment, and for a home visit the rule counts notice in calendar days, so the charge applies.

factor_trace: missed_weekend_dispatch_rate (parameter): missed appointment_date 2026-09-26 is a Saturday -> 75.00. Baseline (published no-show fee 60.00) would give 50.00.
